title: IAM-OS Games Manifest
description: The launcher reads this manifest to populate its games view. Each entry points at a self-contained HTML file under games/{id}/ that consumes the frozen touch contract on ws://localhost:8765 (docs/touch-contract.md).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete.

games.description: Installed games, in the order the launcher should display them.

id.description: Filesystem-safe slug. Must match the games/<id>/ directory name.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the launcher.

entry.description: Path under games/<id>/ to the HTML entry point (typically index.html).

thumbnail.description: Optional path under games/<id>/ to a thumbnail image.
